caption: The drawing consists of four distinct objects arranged on a plain, lightly yellowed background. In the upper left corner, inside a rectangular box, there is a side-view technical drawing of a teapot featuring a rounded body, a domed lid with a knob handle, a looped handle on the left, and a curved spout on the right, all outlined in fine lines. Dominating the right side is a large, round, decorated piece, possibly a tray or mirror, with an ornate border of repeating circular patterns and an intricately engraved central design featuring floral scrollwork, prominent leaves, small circular accents, and the capital letters "R" and "B." The lower left shows a cylindrical container with a slightly domed top, two vertical ornate handles on the sides, and elaborate decorative motifs along the edge and around the base. Directly below the largest object and to the right, a small, detailed relief is depicted, showing a symmetrical, sculpted face surrounded by scrolls and foliage. The entire composition is rendered in finely shaded graphite or ink, giving everything a monochromatic appearance with emphasis on texture and intricate design details.
title: Silver Tankard
